g.text: этот документ существует только на английском
and its apps) is operated by Evgenii Panov,
acting as a private individual under the brands
sosed is an ephemeral, local social service: you
post a short message to people near you right
now, and it fades after a while. Key traits:
• Ephemeral. Messages and chats are temporary
• Area-based, not exact tracking. You choose an
area; we match you to people in that area.
• Low-identity. You use sosed without a
traditional account; identity is tied to your
